subject: MARKET-5PP: estimand pinned, production number NOT_RUN
body:
SHA after push. Unit 2 of 4.

ESTIMAND (one line, before computing): Among settled WIN/LOSS picks with pick_proof_receipt.marketFairProb in (0,1), the fraction of 10 equal-width bins with n≥30 where |mean(marketFairProb)−mean(y)| > 0.05.

WHAT IS VIOLATING WHAT. De-vigged receipt.marketFairProb vs realized pick result (WIN=1, LOSS=0). PUSH/VOID/PENDING out.

WHAT NUMBER WOULD MAKE IT MATTER. ≥1 evaluable violating bin on a sport we intend to price — then market logit is not licensed as a FIXED offset for that sport. Underpowered is not a pass.

PRODUCTION NUMBER: NOT_RUN. We do not hold those rows. Missing input: replica extract of MARKET_CALIBRATION_SQL (picks ⋈ pick_proof_receipts ⋈ games ⋈ sports). IndependentEdge.marketFairProb is the wrong column (signal path is null). docs/data/MARKET_CALIBRATION_2026-09-04.md (nflverse closing MLs 2006-2025, Brier 0.2106) is a different estimand on a different population and is not this 5pp.

The mill already existed. This commit pins the estimand, the kill, the SQL, the runner, and the NOT_RUN so nobody can carry an unmeasured 5% forward as established.
